X-RAY MIRROR

See the skull, brain, muscles and skeleton inside your own body, tracked live through your camera. Hold a hand up to see its bones, or step back to see your whole skeleton.

X-Ray Mirror

Click Start camera, then allow the camera.

Layers

Step back until your shoulders and hips are in the picture.

Click a label to read what that part does.

Quiz

The mirror names a part and you point at it with your finger, or click it.

Look

Mixed reality

Move the lens with your index fingertip. Pinch thumb and finger together to shrink it, spread them to grow it.

Camera and tracking

Fit to my head

Tip: pick the Solid look and set "Real me showing through" to about half, then line the skull up with your face.


    


    

      

        Keyboard shortcuts
        

          
1 – 6
Skull, brain, muscles, eyes, hand bones, body skeleton

          
7 – 0
Teeth and tongue, arteries, nerves, neck bones

          
X
Switch between X-ray and Solid

          
L
Labels on or off

          
S
Save a photo

          
R
Start or stop recording

          
F
Full screen

          
C
Next camera

          
M
Mirror on or off

          
A
Auto-fit to my face

          
Q
Start or end the quiz

          
P
Show or hide these controls

        

      

    


    
The anatomy is a real 3D dataset of one adult, scaled and pinned to your body. It shows where structures typically sit, not a scan of you, and it is not a medical tool. Video is processed on this computer and never uploaded.
